damaCrm.title: DAMA-CRM — Modular High-Performance CRM & ERP
damaCrm.desc: High-concurrency self-hosted modular CRM & ERP for SMEs and enterprises. Real multi-tenant architecture with subdomain routing, legal ISO 19005-1 invoicing (PDF/A-3b & public token digital signatures), bidirectional Apple Calendar (webcal://) and Google Calendar sync, drag-and-drop Kanban sales pipeline, 2FA OTP, RBAC, and full 11-language parity with 116+ automated tests passing and 100% strict TypeScript.
damaCrm.feature1Desc: PDF/A-3b for tax compliance, proforma/corrective invoices, and token digital signatures.
damaCrm.feature2Desc: Strict subdomain isolation, granular permissions, and two-factor authentication (2FA OTP).
damaCrm.feature3Desc: Bidirectional sync via webcal:// and .ics feed for Apple Calendar and Google Calendar.
damaCrm.feature4Desc: Interactive drag-and-drop funnel, reactive WebSockets, and complete 11-language parity.

argusFraud.title: Argus Fraud Radar
argusFraud.desc: Enterprise banking fraud detection platform structured on Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), developed as an academic project for the European UNITA Erasmus+ BIP program at STUCOM Pelai. Processes millions of transactions via PySpark, sub-15ms LightGBM inference, and interactive radar dashboards via FastAPI & Streamlit.

argusFraud.feature2: Bank fraud pattern classification with high-accuracy LightGBM

canvaMcp.title: Canva Connector MCP
canvaMcp.desc: Autonomous local MCP server implementing Anthropic's Model Context Protocol standard to connect AI agents directly to the Canva API. Features secure local OAuth 2.0 PKCE authentication with zero credential leakage and deterministic Zod-typed tool schemas.
canvaMcp.feature: Strict MCP protocol with runtime Zod schema validation for AI assistants.

skeletonMeme.feature: Facial mesh tracking with MediaPipe and OpenCV optimized for CPU with zero thermal throttling.
